implementation: Independent small-axis implementation; references inform scheduling/derivatives, not an official FLA or NVIDIA operator.

references.name: FLA parallel attention
references.used: Stable exp2 softmax and recomputed softmax VJP; all4/5keys fit in one tile, so no online key loop/LSE save.

references.name: NVIDIA TransformerEngine2.20.2 common mHC
references.used: Small stream-axis reductions/FMA and FP32 accumulation rather than tensor-core padding for dimensions below16.

references.name: NVIDIA TransformerEngine2.20.2 PyTorch wrapper
references.used: Functional autograd wrapper pattern; state kernel saves QKV only.

precision: BF16 or FP32 inputs/output/gradients; FP32 dot reductions, probabilities and gradient accumulation; no new BF16 probability quantization.
ownership: Each program owns all queries for its token/head, hence dK/dV have deterministic local reductions without atomics.
scope: Only local attention core. Q/K/V/O dense projections remain PyTorch GEMMs.
